body:
[A10] **Lane assignment (milan-fpga F3b, core half).** Executor [A606], branch `acmp-da-fresh` from main `1ba2735`. Internal review R630, external review R631. The milan-fpga half moves the pin and makes the split build's `DA_GATE` publish this predicate. It follows after milan-fpga #697 merges.

1. Implement acceptance 1–5 in `src/acmp.c` and `include/acmp.h`, with the entity-configuration value through the YAML generator from #20. The registered-Listener input enters through the port. The core keeps its state per source, and per interface where the core is already per interface.
2. Do not change the existing behaviour of any other ACMP path. The existing tests stay green unchanged, apart from those that name the gate.
3. Run the gates on both targets: Linux with gcc and clang, GoogleTest, sanitizers and coverage, plus bare-metal RV32 through `scripts/baremetal.py`. Also run `scripts/validate.py`, the contract, the matrix, the mutation campaign and the traceability gates.
4. STOP if the predicate needs a change outside ACMP (ADP, MAAP or the port contract beyond one input), or if the bare-metal image grows by more than 2 KB.

Post REVIEW READY (or STOP) with the head.

[A606] STOP

Branch: `acmp-da-fresh`
Head: `1ba273540abbdf51ea5d235c0a7e81c0bcb5d475`

The candidate Debug RV32 loadable binary grew from 45744 to 47912 bytes (+2168), exceeding the assignment ceiling of 2048 bytes. Release grew by 1296 bytes. Both freestanding builds and smoke checks passed, as did the preliminary hosted tests and measured coverage.

Stopped at the size limit. The candidate remains uncommitted; the full validation campaign, mutation plants and test-removal escape evidence are incomplete. Handoff and draft PR body record the blocker and partial evidence. No push or PR was made.

[A10] **Ruling on the [A606 STOP](https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-c-stack/issues/24#issuecomment-6126278688).** The 2 KB ceiling in the assignment applies to the shipping (Release) bare-metal image only, measured at 1,296 bytes, which is within it. The Debug figure (+2,168 bytes) is reported in the handoff and is not a limit. Continue from the uncommitted candidate: commit it, run the full validation campaign, the mutation plants and the test-removal escapes, and post REVIEW READY (or STOP) with the head.

[A606] REVIEW READY

Branch: `acmp-da-fresh`
Head: `9ef7bd5281c0bb3f2967b11c5a5d8d74a75755d1`
Base: `1ba273540abbdf51ea5d235c0a7e81c0bcb5d475`

Acceptance 1–5 is complete. The per-source predicate uses valid destination AND (a probe answer accepted within the configured freshness window OR a registered Listener). The one Listener input makes no callbacks; the existing clock and source ports supply the query.

All 28 validation entries returned zero, including GCC, Clang 18 sanitizers, coverage, contracts, conditional matrix, boundary, traceability and inventory. All 363 plants are caught. Each of the 15 new hosted tests has an individual physical-removal escape; the YAML range control also escapes after its test is removed. Both RV32 Debug and Release builds and smoke checks pass.

Final Release loadable image: 35792 to 37096 bytes (+1304), within the 2048-byte ceiling. Debug: 45744 to 47952 (+2208), informational under the ruling. ACMP coverage remains 792/792 lines and 390/390 branches. The working tree is clean. Handoff, review body and evidence are complete. No push or PR creation was performed.

[A10] **Round 2.** R631-1 is POSITIVE ([6127654574](https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-c-stack/pull/25#issuecomment-6127654574)). R630-1 is NEGATIVE ([6127564342](https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-c-stack/pull/25#issuecomment-6127564342)) on one MAJOR and one MINOR finding. Executor [A606].

1. **R630-1-F1 (MAJOR).** "Its test" means the one core test named as the plant's killer. Narrow `examples/entity_roundtrip.c` so it checks only two things:
   - the YAML value reaches `struct acmp_config`;
   - one end-to-end freshness-true path, executed on RV32.

   It no longer repeats the no-probe, edge, wrap, Listener-without-probe or invalid-address terms. Afterwards, each of the 15 `dafresh-*` plants must:
   - be caught by the complete hosted suite (all test binaries) with its killer present;
   - escape when only its killer is removed.

   Publish per-test removal receipts, re-running R630-1's `physical_removal.py` and `escape_probe.py` unchanged, and correct the PR body's claim.
2. **R630-1-F2 (MINOR).** Keep zero's documented meaning: zero disables the probe term, and a Listener still opens the gate. Add a test with a registered plant (R630-1's `x-zero-never-expires`) showing that a probe alone never opens the gate at zero, while a Listener does. Refuse values of 2^31 ms or more in `acmp_init`, with a test.
3. **Residue.** Apply R630-1-R1's exact fix in `docs/PORTING.md`. Make R631-D01's table in `docs/ENTITY_YAML.md` list all four configuration plants.

The Release bare-metal ceiling is unchanged. Post REVIEW READY with the head.

[A606] REVIEW READY

Round 2 head: `0868387deab21bd0db414424f306c7ea62498e29` on `acmp-da-fresh`.

R630-1-F1 and F2 are addressed. The shared round trip now checks configuration and one positive freshness path. All 15 existing freshness plants and both new plants are caught across all eight hosted binaries with their named test present, and escape after only that test is physically removed (418 to 417 completed instances). The supplied review scripts were rerun unchanged; supplemental XML grading covers the complete suites and physical removal of the entity test.

Zero disables probe demand while a Listener still opens the gate. Initialization rejects intervals at or above 2^31 ms. Both requested documentation corrections are applied.

All 28 validation gates returned 0; all 365 registered mutation plants were caught, with zero escapes or errors. GCC, Clang sanitizers, coverage and RV32 Debug/Release pass. ACMP coverage is 792/792 lines and 392/392 branches. Release image: 35792 to 36864 bytes (+1072, below 2048); Debug: 45744 to 47512 (+1768).

HANDOFF.md, PR-BODY.md and Round 2 per-test receipts are ready for publication. One new commit, clean working tree, post-commit privacy gate passed. No push performed; the manager owns publication and final review.

[A10] **Round 3.** R631-2 is POSITIVE ([6128499323](https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-c-stack/pull/25#issuecomment-6128499323)). R630-2 is NEGATIVE ([6128429366](https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-c-stack/pull/25#issuecomment-6128429366)) on one MINOR finding: the promise that a stale answer never comes back after a counter wrap is tested only with no Listener and a valid address. Executor [A606].

1. Add two tests. In each, a probe answer is held across at least 2^32 ms of serviced queries, at intervals inside the documented contract, and must not reappear after the counter aliases:
   - a Listener is registered, then withdrawn;
   - the destination is invalid, then made valid again.
2. Register R630-2's two plants in `tests/mutations.json` (`g-expiry-skipped-with-listener`, `g-expiry-skipped-invalid-da`, or equivalents), each with its own named killer. Each plant must be caught by the complete suite and escape when only its killer is removed. R630-2's `gap_mutants.py` and `physical_removal.py`, unchanged, must report CAUGHT and `escapes: true`. The mutation campaign stays at 0 escapes.
3. Update the TESTS and TRACEABILITY records.

Post REVIEW READY with the head.
